title: Usage-based billing for device telemetry batches
name: Telemetry usage billing

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code turns metered usage into ledger amounts? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Which guarantee does Ledger.Post, together with the store contract, give about everything the ledger holds?
choices: The amounts of all stored entries sum to zero, because only balanced journals are inserted and each is written atomically.
Entries for the same account are stored in the order Post was called.
A journal can be corrected later by posting another journal with the same key.

questions.prompt: The ingestion pipeline redelivers a batch (same ID) after a timeout in which the first Bill call actually succeeded. What happens on the second call?
choices: The account is charged twice, since Bill has no memory of earlier calls.
Post returns ErrUnbalanced because the receivable account already holds the amount.
The tariff lookup fails because it was already consumed by the first call.
The journal key batch:<ID> collides, the store returns ErrDuplicate, and Bill returns nil without a second charge.

questions.prompt: An account's tariff is 2,500 micros per message. A single batch of 6 messages arrives. What does Bill post for the receivable entry?
